judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A pleasant but ordinary daytime sky made more interesting by crossing contrails, though the rooftops keep it from feeling like a pure sky photograph.
strengths: delicate cirrus texture across a wide sky
expansive sky fills most of the frame
weaknesses: rooftops and chimneys clutter the lower edge
flat daylight gives limited color or drama
contrails dominate more than natural cloud forms
